input: Organize a clothing drive for the local shelter

gold.taskTitle: Organize a Clothing Drive for Local Shelter
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a clothing drive to collect and deliver donated clothing items to a local shelter.

questions.title: Which specific shelter are you partnering with?
questions.description: Identify the exact shelter or organization that will receive the donated clothing.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for the clothing drive?
questions.description: Determine the start date, end date, and duration of the collection period.

questions.title: What types of clothing are most needed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the shelter needs specific items such as winter coats, children's clothing, work attire, or general garments.

questions.title: Where will donation drop-off points be located?
questions.description: Decide on the physical locations where people can drop off their donated clothing items.

questions.title: Who is your target donor audience for this drive?
questions.description: Identify whether donations will be sourced from coworkers, neighbors, a school, a community group, or the general public.

questions.title: What is your budget for organizing this drive?
questions.description: Understand how much money is available for expenses such as collection bins, flyers, transportation, and promotion.

questions.title: Do you have volunteers to help collect and sort donations?
questions.description: Determine whether a team is already in place or if recruiting volunteers is also part of the task.
